name: jira-navigator
title: Jira Navigator
description: A personal Jira triage dashboard: your assigned issues grouped by actionable status.
author: daniel_portales_rosado

commands.name: myIssues
commands.title: Issues
commands.subtitle: Jira
commands.description: Your Jira issues grouped by actionable status, scoped by your saved filters

commands.name: openIssueByKey
commands.title: Open Issue
commands.subtitle: Jira
commands.description: Open a Jira issue by its key from the clipboard or argument; other text filters My Issues

preferences.name: site
preferences.title: Jira Site
preferences.description: Your Atlassian Cloud host, without protocol.

preferences.name: email
preferences.title: Account Email
preferences.description: The Atlassian account email used for the API token.

preferences.name: fallbackProjectKey
preferences.title: Fallback Project Key
preferences.description: Project key used by Open Issue when the clipboard or argument holds a number without a project prefix (e.g. 1234 opens PROD-1234). Leave empty to treat bare numbers as a search.

preferences.name: recentlyDoneDays
preferences.title: Recently Done Threshold (days)
preferences.description: Keep RECENTLY DONE to issues moved to Done within the last N days. Set to 0 to hide Done from triage.

preferences.name: transitionDelaySeconds
preferences.title: Status Change Delay (seconds)
preferences.description: Grace period before a status change is sent to Jira, during which Undo cancels it with no API call. Set to 0 to apply immediately.

preferences.name: sectionConfig
preferences.title: Section Config
preferences.description: Optional JSON array overriding the default sections. Leave empty for defaults.

preferences.name: browser
preferences.title: Browser
preferences.description: Which browser to open issues in. Tab reuse is supported for Chromium browsers and Safari; other browsers open a new tab.

preferences.name: reuseExistingTab
preferences.title: Tab Reuse
preferences.label: Focus an already-open tab instead of opening a new one
preferences.description: Only applies to supported browsers (Chromium, Safari) when a specific browser is selected above.

preferences.name: browserApp
preferences.title: Browser App Override
preferences.description: Exact browser to open issues in — a full path (/Applications/Firefox.app) or bundle id (org.mozilla.firefox). Overrides the Browser dropdown above and disambiguates app variants (e.g. regular Firefox vs Developer Edition). Tab reuse is skipped when set.
